message.content: I am a Data Analyst with four years of experience using pandas and scikit-learn. Over that period I led a team of three to build a customer churn model that reduced false‑positive alerts by 18% over six months. My SQL experience, though occasional, has equipped me to query data effectively. I am eager to bring my analytical strengths to your mid‑sized logistics company.
